concerns.location: plan.md:Technical Context (CPU‑first; GPU escape hatch if CPU timeout (60 s) is exceeded)
concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑002 specifies that synthetic code generation must complete in ≤ 30 s per snippet on a standard 2 vCPU runner. The plan allows a 60 s CPU timeout before falling back to a Kaggle GPU, which exceeds the stipulated 30 s limit and therefore does not satisfy FR‑002.
